canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near L'Air du Temps

parent.title: Weekend around L'Air du Temps — Liernu, Belgium, 2026

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of L'Air du Temps
siblings.summary: Seven character stays for a Saturday at L'Air du Temps — from the on-site farmstead and 500 m castle ruins to a 17th-century family château, plus three Namur boutique picks for combining dinner with old-town sightseeing.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of L'Air du Temps
siblings.summary: What to do around chef Sang Hoon Degeimbre's two-star Liernu farmstead — Namur citadel, Floreffe Abbey, Meuse RAVeL, Wépion strawberries, Walibi, Walloon vineyards — picked by drive time and 2026 opening calendar.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of L'Air du Temps
siblings.summary: Five confirmed 2026 IT/tech events sit inside a 30 km circle around L'Air du Temps; KIKK Festival (21–25 Oct) and the CSLabs hackathon (27–29 Mar) are the only ones that cover a Saturday and pair cleanly with the dinner.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: L'Air du Temps is a 2-Michelin-star + green-star restaurant in Liernu (Eghezée), Namur province, listed in the 2026 Michelin Guide Belgium.

sources.title: Quality Lodgings — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: L'Air du Temps has 11 guest rooms on-site at rue de la Croix Monet 2, Eghezée; chef Sang Hoon Degeimbre; 5-hectare gardens.

sources.title: L'Air du Temps — Les Chambres (official)
sources.claim: L'Air du Temps stay packages: Séjour Signature €640/person (excl. Fri/Sat eve) and Séjour Suprématie €730/person; both include 2 menus, aperitifs, 1 night, 2 breakfasts; room upgrades +€20 to +€90; no lift.

sources.title: Belvicci — L'Air du Temps SETTING (hotel)
sources.claim: L'Air du Temps SETTING B&B is priced at ~€210 average for a double room with breakfast; ranked #2 of 13 best hotels in Namur district.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: L'Air du Temps B&B holds 4.6/5 on Tripadvisor (54 reviews); rooms 4.7, sleep quality 5.0; criticism: no A/C in rooftop rooms, tasting-menu only, no 24h reception.

sources.title: Les Ruines du Château — Practically (official)
sources.claim: Les Ruines du Château is at 40 rue du Château, 5310 Eghezée; the property advertises 500m to L'Air du Temps; check-in 17:00, check-out 11:00; free parking.

sources.title: Les Ruines du Château — Our Rooms (official)
sources.claim: Les Ruines du Château offers 2 suites (La Charmante with outdoor jacuzzi; L'Envoûtante with infrared/steam sauna under the castle tower); both have luxury bedding, Wi-Fi, Netflix TV, mini-fridge; bookable together via underground corridor.

sources.title: RTBF — Une nuit au château côté Eghezée
sources.claim: Les Ruines du Château: €200 all-inclusive for the jacuzzi room, €170 for the sauna room; won the public's favourite at Horecatel Hospitality Awards 2025 and 'C'est du Belge' favourite in 2024.

sources.title: Let's Go My Love — Les Ruines du Château
sources.claim: Independent reviewer corroborates Les Ruines du Château is ~500m from L'Air du Temps; 4.8/5 from 30 reviews; breakfast delivered on wooden boards; evening aperitif service.

sources.title: My Boutique Hotel — B&B La Chambre d'à Côté
sources.claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté is at Place d'Aische 10/12, 5310 Eghezée (Aische-en-Refail); 2-3 room types (suite, loft, double); free bike rentals; 9.5/10 from 65 reviews.

sources.title: Booking.com — B&B La Chambre d'à Côté
sources.claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté listed on Booking.com from Aische-en-Refail; 9.4 guest rating; breakfast and host highly rated; rooms with private bathroom and garden view.

sources.title: Kayak — B&B La Chambre d'à Côté
sources.claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté starts from $151/night with nightly rates ranging $113-$159 by season.

sources.title: Belvicci — L'Air du Temps (restaurant)
sources.claim: Belvicci lists Manoir de Thorembais (5.78 km) and Koru (9.86 km) as nearest non-on-site hotels to L'Air du Temps — both outside walking distance.
